Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat

Class MemoryWindowAssembler

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat.MemoryWindowAssembler
@Service public class MemoryWindowAssembler extends Object
Assembles the chat memory window for one turn (REQ-AGT-005 / REQ-CHAT-006).

Returns the last memorySize persisted USER / ASSISTANT messages of the conversation in chronological ascending order. Pure delegate to ConversationRepository.findLastN(ConversationId, int); exists as its own class for three reasons:

  1. The MemorySize → int unwrap is centralized — the domain repository port takes a plain int because the domain cannot depend on application.shared.PageSize, and MemorySize lives in domain.agent.
  2. EPIC-12's DelegationService deliberately bypasses this helper for sub-agent turns (REQ-AGT-015 — no parent history). Having a named bean makes the bypass discoverable in code review.
  3. A future "summarize older history into a single synthetic message" strategy (not in v1) would land as a new method on this class without touching ChatRequestBuilder.

Implementation note: when this turn has already persisted the new USER message (which happens inside SendMessageService's synchronous prefix BEFORE the assembler is called), the returned window includes that new message as its last element. The LLM thus sees memory window = previous (N-1) + new user, all in one query. This deviates from US-11-003's original story spec which proposed assembling pre-existing messages and appending the new one separately; the simpler single-query approach is functionally equivalent because findLastN already orders chronologically ascending.
